base_analysis.semantic_identity: Young male technology creator, approachable technical authority
base_analysis.subject_identity_requirements: Face, dark rectangular glasses, hairstyle, and age cues must remain clearly recognizable. Pose, crop, wardrobe, and environment may change.
existing_composition_constraints: Source uses circular crop; target requires square 1:1 format

observations.description: Centered subject occupies primary vertical axis with upper text zone and lower mechanical object zone
Purple/violet key light illuminates subject from below-center, creating dramatic facial modeling and rim separation
Acid-green fill and accents from upper text region
Layered depth with foreground cables, midground subject, background machinery, and atmospheric haze
Dominant violet-purple palette with acid-green chromatic accent and deep neutral shadows
Central mechanical infinity-shaped object with electrical energy and cables
Overscale acid-green graffiti text 'SEM PROMPTS' in upper third
Subject with raised hands, palms facing inward toward central object
Mixed materials: metal machinery, rubber cables, fabric blazer, glass/energy
Purple electrical lightning and glow emanating from central object

reference_dna.hierarchy: centered dominance with upper and lower supporting zones
reference_dna.lighting: purple key with green accent, dramatic contrast
reference_dna.depth: layered mechanical atmosphere with foreground occlusion

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Subject remains centered in square thumbnail; upper zone reserved for calm negative space or clean technical graphics, lower zone features target-native technical focal element
design_decision_map.rationale: Centered dominance creates ceremonial stability and immediate hierarchy essential for personal brand recognition in a square thumbnail format

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Purple/violet key light from below or screen source models subject face and glasses; green accent used sparingly on technical elements or rim
design_decision_map.rationale: Purple lighting communicates technical authority and invention; must be balanced with fill to preserve facial recognizability and glasses clarity

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Layered technical environment using server racks, code screens, circuit patterns, or data visualization planes instead of mechanical machinery
design_decision_map.rationale: Layered depth creates immersion and technical context; must be native to technology personal brand rather than generic industrial aesthetic

cross_category_adaptation.visual_function: create layered depth, technical context, and environmental immersion
cross_category_adaptation.emotional_effect: technical authority, complex capability, energetic environment
cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: server infrastructure, code displays, circuit patterns, data visualization layers, or abstract geometric tech architecture
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: A technology personal brand belongs in a digital/technical environment, not generic industrial machinery; server racks and code screens communicate the same technical authority while remaining truthful to the creator's domain

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Maintain violet-purple dominant value structure with controlled chromatic accent; accent may be green or target-owned technical hue
design_decision_map.rationale: Violet-purple creates technical energy and premium darkness; accent provides vitality and focal contrast

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Replace literal infinity mechanical assembly with target-native technical focal point: holographic interface, code stream, circuit diagram, or abstract data visualization with motivated glow
design_decision_map.rationale: The function is a central technical focal point demonstrating mastery; the literal infinity symbol and mechanical assembly are source-specific and prohibited by brief

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: No text overlay per brief constraints; typography function replaced by subject and technical environment hierarchy
design_decision_map.rationale: Source text 'SEM PROMPTS' is prohibited; graffiti style conflicts with technical authority tone; brief specifies text_overlay_expected false

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Subject pose adapts to interacting with target-native technical elements (gesturing toward screen, touching device, or open hands showing engagement) while keeping face and glasses front-facing and recognizable
design_decision_map.rationale: Active hand position communicates engagement and control; exact reference hand pose and mechanical object interaction are not required

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Material contrast between subject wardrobe (fabric) and technical environment (metal, glass, screen) preserved; specific industrial materials replaced with clean tech materials
design_decision_map.rationale: Material contrast enriches hierarchy and tactile interest; must remain native to technology domain

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Subject face, facial geometry, dark rectangular glasses, hairstyle, and age cues must remain clearly recognizable
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: User-supplied identity asset with STRICT preservation level; outranks all reference attraction

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Centered subject dominance for immediate recognition in square thumbnail
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Reference demonstrates effective centered authority; supports thumbnail legibility at small sizes

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Purple/violet technical lighting creating dramatic modeling and technical atmosphere
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Core lighting DNA of reference; communicates invention and technical mastery

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Layered depth with foreground, subject, and background planes creating environmental immersion
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Creates scale and technical world around subject; essential for authority

flexible_areas.rationale: Reference blazer is not identity-critical; can adapt to target-native technical attire while maintaining authority
Mechanical machinery is reference-specific; can be replaced with any target-native technical environment (servers, code, circuits, data viz)
Reference hand pose is tied to prohibited mechanical object; can adapt to any gesture that communicates engagement with technical elements
Acid-green is reference-specific; can shift to target-owned technical accent or remain as green if it serves the hierarchy
Central infinity assembly is prohibited; any target-native technical focal point (hologram, code, device) can serve the function
Specific cables and machinery are incidental; any coherent technical background with similar depth and light behavior works

risks.description: Purple key light could wash out facial recognition or create unreadable glasses reflections
risks.mitigation: Balance purple key with controlled fill on face; ensure glasses have subtle, readable reflections; test recognizability at thumbnail size

risks.description: Technical environment could become generic cyberpunk cliché (random cables, neon without source)
risks.mitigation: Use specific target-native elements (actual code, real hardware, verified technical artifacts) with motivated lighting and plausible geometry

risks.description: Energy effects could become unmotivated 'AI glow' without physical or graphic source
risks.mitigation: Attach all glow to specific emitters: screens, LEDs, data streams, or circuit traces with coherent light direction

risks.description: Dramatic lighting or environment could obscure subject identity
risks.mitigation: Keep face in shadow-controlled zone with sufficient fill; preserve hairline and glasses edge definition; maintain age cues

risks.description: Temptation to add text overlay or graffiti style to fill upper zone
risks.mitigation: Respect brief constraint text_overlay_expected=false; use environmental depth or clean technical graphics instead of text

provenance.notes: Image A is identity-only asset; Image B is primary visual reference. Subject identity protected throughout. Reference text and literal infinity assembly excluded per user constraints.

confidence.rationale: Reference provides strong, actionable visual DNA in lighting, hierarchy, depth, and energy. Subject identity constraints are clear, non-conflicting with reference mechanisms, and strictly enforceable. Transfer plan offers specific target-native alternatives without over-specifying final composition.
